# Link Sentinel — CWI Catalog & App Estate Link Radar

Weekly dead-link radar over the That Boy Hi Hat catalog streaming links and every live CWI app URL.

## Machine-readable endpoints
- /data/links.json — link records, schema cwi.link-record/1.0 (id, label, url, kind, source)
- /data/results.json — latest scan, schema cwi.link-scan/1.0 (statuses LIVE/REDIRECT/DEAD/ERROR/UNCHECKED; truth VERIFIED only for LIVE)
- /results.schema.json — JSON Schema for cwi.link-scan/1.0
- /sentinel.js — zero-dep UMD check engine (browser + Node)

## Agent rule
Only use rows with status LIVE and truth VERIFIED when resolving catalog or app links. Everything else is UNVERIFIED by construction.
